verses.english: “Mendicants, these two misrepresent the Realized One.

verses.pali: Yo ca abhāsitaṁ alapitaṁ tathāgatena bhāsitaṁ lapitaṁ tathāgatenāti dīpeti, yo ca bhāsitaṁ lapitaṁ tathāgatena abhāsitaṁ alapitaṁ tathāgatenāti dīpeti.
verses.english: One who explains what was not spoken by the Realized One as spoken by him. And one who explains what was spoken by the Realized One as not spoken by him.

verses.pali: Ime kho, bhikkhave, dve tathāgataṁ abbhācikkhantīti.
verses.english: These two misrepresent the Realized One.
These two don’t misrepresent the Realized One.

verses.pali: Yo ca abhāsitaṁ alapitaṁ tathāgatena abhāsitaṁ alapitaṁ tathāgatenāti dīpeti, yo ca bhāsitaṁ lapitaṁ tathāgatena bhāsitaṁ lapitaṁ tathāgatenāti dīpeti.
verses.english: One who explains what was not spoken by the Realized One as not spoken by him. And one who explains what was spoken by the Realized One as spoken by him.

verses.pali: Ime kho, bhikkhave, dve tathāgataṁ nābbhācikkhantī”ti.
verses.english: These two don’t misrepresent the Realized One.”
